item.title: The sky feels different when something impossible happens
item.description: I've seen eclipses before, but there is something strange about watching daylight change because an object hundreds of thousands of kilometres away moved into exactly the right place.

item.title: Somewhere after 42 kilometres, the run changed
item.description: A reflection on how a long run becomes a series of smaller negotiations with yourself.

item.title: Why Interstellar keeps pulling me back
item.description: Why an enormous story about space stays grounded in a few human relationships.
